summary.en: Convent is from Latin conventus ‘assembly, meeting’, the participial noun of convenire ‘come together’. Convention is from Latin conventio ‘meeting, agreement’, also from convenire. They are genuine relatives, but convention is not derived from the religious-institution sense of convent.
